abstract: Defines the class structure and selector/wait discipline for Playwright Page Object classes targeting an Angular app: a shared BasePage contract (route, constructor(page: Page), navigate()), get-accessor locators, and verify* assertion methods that assert internally instead of returning a boolean. Specifies a role-then-label-then-testid-then-CSS selector priority ladder, action methods that call named readiness-wait helpers instead of a bare waitForTimeout(), a deterministic one-file-per-route naming rule, and a hard boundary keeping business/domain flow logic out of page objects. Encodes 6 invariants plus reference templates for a shared BasePage class and a before/after example page object.
